name: KR Motors Co., Ltd.
summary: Founded in 1917 and headquartered in Changwon, South Korea, KR Motors Co., Ltd. is a prominent global manufacturer and seller of motorcycles. The company's extensive product line encompasses various vehicle types, including traditional bikes, scooters, all-terrain vehicles (ATVs), electric models, and business-oriented transport solutions. Beyond vehicle production, KR Motors also engages in the disassembling and distribution of second-hand automobiles. The firm underwent a name change in April 2014, transitioning from its former identity as S&T Motors Co., Ltd. to its current designation.
